context.books: Passed by the local tool server and ignored. This tool does not read or write the books.

tools.name: folio_pdf_desk
tools.description: Show the pinned external Folio PDF reader and identify a local PDF by size and sha256, or compare a local git clone to that pin. This does not install, launch, or download Folio, and it does not parse document text.

action.description: provenance prints the pin. slip identifies one local PDF. compare-checkout reads git metadata in a local clone.

path.description: Local PDF for slip, or local Folio clone for compare-checkout. Omit for provenance.
